achievements.name: The Beginning
achievements.description: Now you’ve got the hang of shaping hills and you're all set to help the old man on his journey.

achievements.name: Adeline the Village Gossiper
achievements.description: Adeline likes to think she is always in the know of the latest events in the little village.

achievements.name: Window Piano
achievements.description: As a strange consequence of erosion, the hotel window shutters create a harmonic range of squeaks.

achievements.name: Kassiopeia the Tortoise
achievements.description: Kassiopeia is an elusive creature, but will reveal herself for those with patience.

achievements.name: Hugo the Vagabond
achievements.description: Hugo likes to invite passing hikers for a pause and a game of Canasta.

achievements.name: Frogs' Chorus
achievements.description: A small group of frogs with big vocal ambitions.

achievements.name: Georges the Lighthouse Keeper
achievements.description: Georges spends most of his time indulging in his passion for fishing.

achievements.name: Smooth Ride
achievements.description: Ride the train without an emergency break.

achievements.name: Sheep Whisperer
achievements.description: Guide the sheep in a level with the minimal amount of interactions.

achievements.name: Enjoy the Ride
achievements.description: Drive the truck for one mile.

achievements.name: Tilda the Whiz Kid
achievements.description: Tilda developed an uncanny talent to repair things after she discovered her dad's toolbox.

achievements.name: Albert the Gardener
achievements.description: Albert worked an office job in finance before he dared to fulfill his dream and became a gardener.

achievements.name: The End
achievements.description: Watched the credits to the end.
